name: Data2DSL
summary: Evidence-first deterministic data comparison and observation normalization layer.
description: data2dsl compares facts acquired from disparate sources (Markdown, GitHub, AST analyzers, Browser/Curllm, Planfile, Deta, IntentContracts) against bounded queries, producing deterministic comparison outcomes with SHA-256 provenance chains.
useCases: Deterministically compare claimed activity in work-summary.md against measured GitHub commits.
Verify code implementation against declared schemas or planfile task queues.
Execute automated quality gate comparisons with typed deltas.
